args.title: Fix local time zone hour calculation for non-integer offset zones
args.body:
File: src/util/dates.ts

Fix `localHour` and related time zone calculations by using the proper hour and minute parts in the requested time zone rather than falling back to UTC parts or incorrect offsets for non-integer hour offsets (such as India Standard Time UTC+5:30 and Newfoundland Standard Time UTC-3:30/UTC-2:30).
